sermons.title: Sermon 153 | The Mysteries of the Brazen Serpent

scripture.verse: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Before Jehovah's awful throng, Ye nations bow with sacred joy; Know that the Lord is God alone;
scripture.reference: He can create and he destroy.

scripture.verse: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord and thy redeemer the Holy one of Israel.
Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel.
We know that all things work together far good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
It shall come to pass that at evening time it shall be light.

sermons.title: Sermon 161 | The Security of the Church

scripture.verse: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
